policy: bond length 0.70..1.30 covalent radius sum; 1,3 distance >=0.85 A; other nonbonded >=0.65 vdW sum (0.58 when H involved); fragments packed separately; 3D transitions discrete
limits: Screen rejects grossly implausible endpoints. It does not validate free energy, force-field applicability, solvent structure, optimized intermediates or a collision-free chemical reaction trajectory. 2D projection overlap is not a 3D collision.
